original_title: Big Walk Is Destined To Be Your Next Big Co-Op Obsession
summary_en: The masterminds behind Untitled Goose Game are back with a massive co-op exploration title. Big Walk promises a huge island filled with secrets and puzzles for up to 12 players.
ai_analysis: This title leans into the emergent, player-driven chaos that made House House's previous work so beloved, but scales it up for a larger group experience.

en.title: House House Drops Big Walk: Your Next Co-op Obsession Arrives August 2026
en.summary: The masterminds behind Untitled Goose Game are back with a massive co-op exploration title. Big Walk promises a huge island filled with secrets and puzzles for up to 12 players.
en.body:
Get ready to gather your friends, because **House House** has just unveiled their next project: **Big Walk**. Following the runaway success and anarchic charm of **Untitled Goose Game**, the acclaimed Australian developer is setting its sights on a sprawling co-operative adventure designed for maximum social interaction. Slated for release on **August 4, 2026**, **Big Walk** drops players onto a vast, mysterious island where exploration, puzzle-solving, and plenty of laughter are the order of the day.

This isn't a game for lone wolves. **Big Walk** is built from the ground up for cooperative play, supporting groups of two to twelve players. Venturing into the unknown island in first-person as customizable, vaguely human avatars, your primary tools will be communication and collaboration. The game eschews heavy-handed tutorials, instead encouraging organic discovery and emergent gameplay. Expect physics-based puzzles, proximity chat that fosters genuine interaction (and potential mischief), and challenges that will test your group's ability to adapt when your freedom of movement, communication methods, or even your physical space are dynamically altered. The core loop revolves around simple pillars: walking and talking, but the ingenious ways these are challenged promise a deeply rewarding, and often hilariously chaotic, experience.

## A World of Puzzles and Secrets

The island setting in **Big Walk** is designed to be a living playground, brimming with secrets waiting to be unearthed. The developers have emphasized that solving smaller, intricate puzzles will gradually unlock access to new areas and grander challenges. This sense of progression, coupled with the lack of explicit guidance, mirrors the satisfying exploration found in open-world RPGs, but reframed for a shared, social context. The emphasis is on shared discovery and the joy of figuring things out together, even if that involves a bit of playful sabotage or comical failure. The satisfaction of cracking a particularly tricky environmental puzzle, or piecing together a larger mystery, is a core part of the appeal.

## The Hangout Game You've Been Waiting For

In a world saturated with competitive multiplayer and intense raids, **Big Walk** looks poised to fill a unique niche: the ultimate hangout game. The freedom to explore, the reliance on voice chat, and the inherent silliness of the premise make it an ideal title for friends looking to simply spend time together in a virtual space. The developers at **House House** have a proven track record of creating experiences that are both deeply engaging and surprisingly funny, and **Big Walk** appears to be a natural evolution of that design philosophy. It’s a game that understands that sometimes, the best gaming moments come not from achieving grand victories, but from the shared journey and the stories you create along the way.

## What's Next

**Big Walk** is set to launch on **August 4, 2026**, for PC and consoles, with a day-one release on PlayStation confirmed. Keep an eye on official channels for further gameplay reveals and potential beta opportunities as the launch date approaches.

tr.title: House House'tan Büyük Adım: Bir Sonraki Kooperatif Bağımlılığınız Ağustos 2026'da Geliyor
tr.summary: Untitled Goose Game'in yaratıcıları yeni bir projeyle döndü: Büyük Adım. Bu büyük ölçekli kooperatif keşif oyunu, 12 oyuncuya kadar gizemler ve bulmacalarla dolu devasa bir ada vaat ediyor. House House'un yeni oyunu Ağustos 2026'da PC ve konsollarda çıkacak.
tr.body:
House House, yeni projesi Büyük Adım'ı tanıttı. Untitled Goose Game'in ardından gelen bu yeni oyun, maksimum sosyal etkileşim için tasarlanmış bir合作 macerası vaat ediyor. 4 Ağustos 2026'da çıkacak Büyük Adım, oyuncuları bir gizemli adaya bırakıyor; burada keşif, bulmaca çözme ve eğlence günün sıralamasında yer alıyor.

Bu, yalnız kurtlar için bir oyun değil. Büyük Adım, iki ila on iki oyuncuya kadar destekleyen bir合作 oyun olarak tasarlandı. İlk kişi perspektifinde, özelleştirilebilir ve insan benzeri avatarlar olarak bilinmeyen adaya giriyorsunuz. İletişim ve işbirliği, ana araçlarınız olacak. Oyun, ağır/tutorial'leri reddederek, organik keşif ve ortaya çıkan oyunları teşvik ediyor. Fizik tabanlı bulmacalar, gerçek etkileşim ve potansiyel kargaşa yaratabilen yakınlık sohbeti bekleyin. Freedom of movement, iletişim yöntemleri veya fiziksel alanınız dinamik olarak değiştirildiğinde, grubunuzun uyum sağlama yeteneğini test edecek meydan okumalarla karşılaşacaksınız. Ana döngü, basit sütunlar üzerine kuruludur: yürüme ve konuşma, ancak bu şekilde meydan okumalar, derinlemesine ödüllendirici ve souvent komik bir kaos vaat ediyor.

## Bir Dizi Bulmaca ve Gizem Dünyası

Büyük Adım'daki ada ortamı, yaşamaya uygun bir oyun alanı olarak tasarlandı; gizli gizli bekleyen sırlarla dolu. Geliştiriciler, küçük, karmaşık bulmacaları çözmek, yeni alanlara ve daha büyük meydan okumalara erişim sağlayacağını vurguladılar. Bu ilerleme hissi, açık dünya RPG'lerinde bulunan tatmin edici keşif experience'ini yansıtıyor, ancak paylaşılan, sosyal bir bağlam için yeniden şekillendirildi. Vurgu, paylaşılan keşif ve birlikte şeyler çözmekteki zevke geliyor; bu, biraz oyunbaz sabotaj veya komik başarısızlık içerebilir. Özellikle zorlu bir çevresel bulmacayı çözmek veya daha büyük bir gizemi parçalamak, oyunun çekiciliğinin temel bir parçasıdır.

## Beklediğiniz Toplanma Oyunu

Rekabetçi çok oyunculu ve yoğun raids'in doldurduğu bir dünyada, Büyük Adım benzersiz bir niş doldurmak için hazır görünüyor: ultimate toplanma oyunu. Keşif özgürlüğü, sesli sohbet bağımlılığı ve komik premise, arkadaşların sanal bir alanda birlikte zaman geçirmek için ideal bir başlık haline geliyor. House House geliştiricileri, hem derinlemesine etkileyici hem de şaşırtıcı şekilde komik deneyimler yaratma konusunda kanıtlanmış bir geçmişe sahip; Büyük Adım, bu tasarım felsefesinin doğal bir evrimi gibi görünüyor. Bu, en iyi gaming anlarının, büyük zaferler elde etmekten değil, paylaşılan yolculuk ve yaratılan hikayelerden geldiğini anlayan bir oyun.

## Sonraki Adımlar

Büyük Adım, 4 Ağustos 2026'da PC ve konsollarda çıkacak; PlayStation için günbirlik sürüm onaylandı. Lansman tarihine yaklaşırken resmi kanallardan daha fazla oyun oynama açıklamaları ve potansiyel beta fırsatları için gözünüzü dört açın.

content_raw: Often my job involves playing games before they come out. Sometimes, this means I'll come away feeling like I've just played the next big thing. That's one of the most exciting parts of my job, really, and it happened yesterday; I'm certain Big Walk is the next big thing. Developed by Untitled Goose Game's House House, Big Walk is a two- to 12-player co-op game in which you explore a huge island full of puzzles and secrets. Playing in first-person as vaguely human-like, customizable avatars, you and your group will solve all sorts of puzzles in a game that is perhaps most reminiscent of Peak, but ultimately does a lot of things in its own special way. Big Walk drops you onto its island setting with virtually no hand-holding. There's a you're happening upon discoveries. It's the same unguided approach an open-world RPG so often demonstrates and benefits from, but remolded into a co-op world where physics, proximity chat, and a bit of comical failure--or even some playful undermining of your group's goals--are key ingredients. Without a doubt, this is going to be the next great hangout game. I don't want to spoil any other puzzles, so instead I'll say it's a game designed on two simple pillars: walking and talking, routinely challenging you to adapt when things like your freedom of movement, ability to communicate, and the physical space in which you stand are altered. Each problem demands a solution, and finding one is incredibly rewarding, but the stumbles along the way are their own kind of highlight.  The smaller puzzles we solved for each eggy thing eventually led to a bigger puzzle. That then opened up more of the island, including a tutorial finish line where we could write messages on whiteboards we could carry, perhaps to be used in the future to communicate across great distances. Puzzles also scale for each team size, meaning a full-size group of 12 may benefit from sending out smaller squads in different directions, but will also likely need to convene as one big party to collect more eggy things and get past some of the game's obstacles, as they'll take on different shapes than what we saw as a trio.  Unlike a lot of the best friendslop games , Big Walk has a definitive ending, which is said to be reachable in about 12-20 hours. That seems to translate to dozens of puzzles to solve, many paths to explore, and countless ways to goof off. It comes out on August 4 for PC, PS5, and Switch 2, and I would bet all of my eggy things that it goes viral. My kids and I had a blast with it, and we left our demo so excited to get back to the full game to see what awaits us farther down the path of our big walk.
